5571-6331-8249--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6331-8249--6.description:
Use Stiltzkin to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

950-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4022-4772-5926-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

1594-4399-4770-6097.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1368-1563-6321-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-7297.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4377-4823-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
2034-6972-7325.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Repeat.

3534-5147-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
3534-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
3534-5147-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

3705-5231-6026-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Field of Souls triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3946-5451-6701.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3705-5231-5997-6633.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1651-3715-4321-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-4321-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and a Food artifact token
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue and Food, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

152-1283-3129-4600.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

413-708-2459-4753.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator is a copy of Myth Unbound.
413-708-2459-4753.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

539-618-3821.description:
Activate up to four mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
The token Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki and up to four other lands.
Repeat.

813-1777-1893.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Shallow Grave by paying {1}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Shallow Grave from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
